omniget.description:
OmniGet is a free desktop app that downloads videos, courses, books and music from the internet — then plays them inside. One window, no setup, your files stay on your computer.
Free open-source video, music and course downloader. Grab from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Udemy, Hotmart and 1000+ sites via yt-dlp. Then watch, read and listen inside the app. No terminal, no setup.
